title: A Clean Park for Everyone
text:
Maria lives near a big park in her city. Many people visit the park every day, but there is a lot of litter on the grass. Some visitors throw bottles and bags on the ground. This makes the park look dirty and sad.

Last month, Maria started a small group with her neighbours. They pick up rubbish every Saturday morning. Now more people help, and the park is much cleaner. Maria says that small actions can change a community.

questions.text: When does Maria's group pick up rubbish?
What can you infer about the people who throw litter on the grass?
options: They do not care about the park

questions.text: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: Parks should be closed to visitors
Small actions can help a community
Maria wants to move away from the city

vocabulary.definition: small pieces of rubbish left in a public place
a group of people who live in the same area

paragraph_translations: Maria vive cerca de un parque grande en su ciudad. Muchas personas visitan el parque todos los días, pero hay mucha basura tirada en el césped. Algunos visitantes tiran botellas y bolsas en el suelo. Esto hace que el parque se vea sucio y triste.

El mes pasado, Maria empezó un pequeño grupo con sus vecinos. Ellos recogen basura todos los sábados por la mañana. Ahora más personas ayudan, y el parque está mucho más limpio. Maria dice que las pequeñas acciones pueden cambiar una comunidad.
